description: CREATE FUNCTION with parameterized argument types - VARCHAR(n), DECIMAL(p,s), TIMESTAMP(p), CHAR(n), NUMBER(p)/NUMBER(p,s), mixed lists, OR REPLACE with the same signature, schema-qualified names - each verified to exist via SHOW USER FUNCTIONS, then dropped by its signature. A routine's signature is stored under its CANONICAL type FAMILY (live-verified): DROP f(VARCHAR) drops a CHAR(10) parameter, DROP f(NUMBER) a DECIMAL one. Converted 1:1 from ddl/CreateFunctionWithTypeParametersTest (now retired; it ran over JDBC but was pure SQL).

steps.sql: CREATE FUNCTION greet(name VARCHAR(100)) RETURNS VARCHAR LANGUAGE SQL AS 'name'
CREATE FUNCTION calculate_tax(amount DECIMAL(10, 2)) RETURNS DECIMAL LANGUAGE SQL AS 'amount'
CREATE FUNCTION format_time(ts TIMESTAMP(9)) RETURNS VARCHAR LANGUAGE SQL AS 'ts::VARCHAR'
CREATE FUNCTION format_record(id INTEGER, name VARCHAR(50), amount DECIMAL(10, 2)) RETURNS VARCHAR LANGUAGE SQL AS 'name'
CREATE FUNCTION process_data(id INTEGER, description VARCHAR(255), count INTEGER, price DECIMAL(8, 2)) RETURNS VARCHAR LANGUAGE SQL AS 'description'
DROP FUNCTION process_data(INTEGER, VARCHAR, INTEGER, DECIMAL)
CREATE FUNCTION validate_code(code CHAR(10)) RETURNS INTEGER LANGUAGE SQL AS '1'
CREATE FUNCTION compute_total(value NUMBER(12)) RETURNS NUMBER LANGUAGE SQL AS 'value'

CREATE FUNCTION update_record(id INTEGER, data VARCHAR(200)) RETURNS VARCHAR LANGUAGE SQL AS 'data'
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION update_record(id INTEGER, data VARCHAR(200)) RETURNS VARCHAR LANGUAGE SQL AS 'data'

DROP FUNCTION full_typed(VARCHAR, NUMBER, NUMBER, VARCHAR)
CREATE FUNCTION typed_func(amount DECIMAL(10, 2)) RETURNS DECIMAL LANGUAGE SQL AS 'amount'
CREATE FUNCTION typed_func(amount DECIMAL(10, 2)) RETURNS DECIMAL LANGUAGE SQL AS 'amount'
